title: resourceRequest
responsibility: Resolves explicit or automatic CPU and memory requests against live headroom or an inherited parent reservation.

inputs.name: resourceRequest.flags
inputs.description: String-valued CLI fields consumed for priority, CPU, memory and label. `cpus` and `memoryMib` are converted with `Number` unless exactly `"auto"`; auto uses live headroom and top-level running-job reservations, or parent lease values, while undefined priority and label values receive schema defaults.

inputs.name: resourceRequest.service
inputs.description: Resource service view with a `home` path, asynchronous `snapshot()`, and `queue.all()`; it supplies the configuration path, live telemetry and jobs to inspect. Only running jobs without a `parentId` are subtracted from available CPU and memory.

inputs.name: resourceRequest.env
inputs.description: Environment values used to detect `HARNESS_RESOURCE_LEASE` and read `HARNESS_RESOURCE_CPUS` or `HARNESS_RESOURCE_MEMORY_MIB` for automatic sizing under a parent lease; inherited values are passed through `Number` without a local-sizing fallback. Defaults to `process.env`.

outputs.name: resourceRequest
outputs.description: The strict-schema request containing priority, resolved CPU count, memory in MiB and label. Automatic values use current resource availability and reservations, or inherited parent environment values; explicit CPU and memory strings are converted to numbers first.

errors.name: ZodError
errors.description: The final strict request parse throws when priority is not agent-test, coding or environment, CPU or memory is non-finite or non-positive, or label is not 1–100 characters.
